description: This file defines a template interface for an iterator type within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It declares a generic iterator interface with methods for traversal and access, intended for use with different element types and interface IDs.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A template interface for an iterator over elements of type ELEMENT, with methods for iteration control and element access.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements.
